data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 浮空花廊的傲娇花嫁
data.description: 【A 市高层花廊·黄昏】龙卷用念动力托住裙摆，穿着黑绿相间的婚纱悬浮在玫瑰花廊中央；她一手抱花、一手叉腰，先嫌弃头纱太长，听见钟声后却把脸别开，耳尖泛起不肯承认的红。
data.location: high-rise rose promenade above City A
data.action: 玫瑰花廊上用念动力托起头纱悬浮，听见钟声后别脸耳尖发红
data.lighting: emerald sunset with rim light around the veil
data.mood: 最强超能力者不肯承认的柔软
data.promptProse: Tatsumaki floats in the high-rise rose arcade, telekinesis holding her black-and-emerald wedding skirt above the floor. She hugs her bouquet with one hand and rests the other at her hip, turning away with reddened ears as the bell sounds. The vertical medium-full view shows the layered veil and receding flower arch. Emerald sunset rims the veil and green curls, with reflected colored light defining the gown's raised folds.
